Class GameTestsAspectVariables

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.gametest.GameTestsAspectVariables
public class GameTestsAspectVariables extends Object
Tests for aspect settings (aspect properties) that are driven by variables.

  • Nested Class Summary

    Nested Classes
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    protected static class 
    GameTestsAspectVariables.CapturingValueNotifier
    A minimal value notifier that captures values in-memory, so that the server-to-client value syncing can be verified without a network connection.
    static class 
    GameTestsAspectVariables.RecordingContainerPartWriter
    A writer part gui container that records the values that would be synced to the client, instead of sending them over the network.
